name: scd4x
label: Sensirion SCD4x: CO2, temperature and humidity
description:
The SCD40/SCD41 command set: read_measurement (0xEC05, CO2 in ppm, temperature and humidity),
get_data_ready_status (always ready), get_serial_number, the settings (temperature offset,
altitude, ambient pressure, automatic self-calibration: what the DUT sets reads back), forced
recalibration (answers a correction of 0), self test (passes), and every command without an
answer (start and stop periodic measurement, low-power mode, single shot, persist, reinit,
factory reset, power down and wake up) is acknowledged. Each answer word comes with its CRC-8.
The read commands take 1 ms (reads are not acknowledged before), as on the part.

The slow commands (stop_periodic_measurement 500 ms, measure_single_shot 5 s,
perform_self_test 10 s, persist_settings 800 ms) return no data or are read after the DUT's
own wait, so the pod only acknowledges them. The temperature offset is stored but does not
change the reading, and factory reset does not restore the settings. Why the SCD4x and not the
SCD30: the SCD30 holds the clock while it prepares an answer, needs 3 ms between command and
read, and sends IEEE floats.

word_crc.return: n == 0 ? byte(w, 1) : n == 1 ? byte(w, 0) : crc8(0x31, 0xFF, byte(w, 1), byte(w, 0))
